methodology.annual_growth: Per-road-link SQL-weighted contextual estimate using historical traffic position surface functional class weather seasonality economic and freight demand investment context and evidence confidence.
methodology.network_reporting: Link results are aggregated with Average Daily Traffic multiplied by link length so every available road record contributes without selective reporting.
methodology.monthly_growth: Matched traffic count station same-month growth where available; otherwise compounded from the contextual annual road-link estimate.
methodology.weather: Weather sensitivity is represented by variability in ATC-derived monthly seasonal factors with regional and national fallbacks.
methodology.economic: Economic demand is represented by OD trip-end demand and observed heavy-vehicle share.
methodology.position: Position combines proximity to the demand-weighted national-network centre and OD accessibility.
